description: This file defines a class 'Handle' for managing UI interactions related to image and element resizing within the Summernote WYSIWYG editor, including event handling, element positioning, and resize logic.

classes.name: Handle
classes.description: A class managing resize handles and related interactions for elements in Summernote editor.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Handle instance with context and sets up event handlers.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Creates resize handle UI elements and binds event listeners for resizing and scrolling.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the handle UI elements from DOM.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the position and size of the handle overlay based on the target element, and manages selection info.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the handle overlay and clears the current target.
